weaknesses.title: CLAIM has no dead-owner reclaim — orphan job file wedges forever
weaknesses.detail: Unlike flock release-on-exit, CREATEEXCL claim file persists after crash. Next CLAIM busy until manual RM. Same class as LOCKFILE orphan but no unlock protocol either.
weaknesses.repro: CLAIM j; kill; CLAIM j → busy

weaknesses.title: CLAIM vs LOCKFILE vs TOUCH lease — three exclusion models
weaknesses.detail: Agents mix create-excl, flock path.lock, and TOUCH markers. Semantics and release paths differ; false safety common.
weaknesses.repro: CLAIM job vs LOCKFILE plate vs TOUCH agent.lock

weaknesses.title: CLAIM custom body omits trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: worker=alpha glued to next cat; default PID body has NL. Inconsistent body hygiene.

weaknesses.title: No CLAIM→done rename; finish pattern must WRITE then RM loses audit
weaknesses.detail: Agent finish overwrites claim body then deletes path. Durable done archive requires COPY before RM glue.
weaknesses.repro: finish removes claim; no done plate left

weaknesses.title: STAT missing OK=1 EXIST=0 vs empty path OK=0 — dual soft miss
weaknesses.detail: Path miss soft true; empty path hard soft-fail. Agents sharing miss handlers confuse codes.

weaknesses.title: STAT dual with EXIST+SIZE+MTIME+ISFILE family
weaknesses.detail: One-shot STAT helps but old multi-call patterns remain; SIZE alone soft-miss differs.

weaknesses.title: CLAIM does not create parent dirs
weaknesses.detail: Agent must MKDIR parent; language create-excl fails on missing parent. Board works around with DIRNAME+MKDIR.

workarounds: RM orphan claims on deploy recovery / age GC via STAT_AGE

Prefer CLAIM for one-shot jobs; LOCKFILE for reentrant CS
